content.rendered:
Sofitel Hotel DJ Redwood Shores – Redwood City , Bay Area, California

Now named The Pullman Hotel Group, redwood city.
September 13th 2014

American Chinese Wedding on the Peninsula.

Also The Houston Texans were in the next Banquet Room.




1. Grand Entrance:

Catch Me-Demi Lovato

2. Dinner Time:

You are beautiful-James Blunt

Mirrors-Justin Timeberlake

A thousand year- Christina Perri

Marry me-Train

You belong to me-Petula Clark

Everything-Michael Buble

La vie en rose

Only Time-Enya

Marry you-Bruno Mars

You and me-life house

Just a kiss-Lady Antebellum

Glad you came-The Wanted

Good Life-One Republic

We are young- Janelle Monae

You Belong with Me-Taylor Swift

I’m yours-Jason Mraz

Lucky Jason Mraz & Colbie Caillat

R&B

After all I said and done – marc nelson ft beyonce

When I said I do-chante & Kennylatti more
Here and now – Luther Vandross

I Gotta be-Jagged Edge

The only one for me – brian mcknight

3. Cheer & Toast

4. Bouquet Toss:

Drump Beeps

5. Games :

6. Felix’s two songs (after dessert, before party)

周柏豪 Pakho Chau – 我的宣言 My Vow

蕭敬騰 Jam Hsiao 你知道嗎
7. Party Times:

High Music:

Disco Inferno-50 cent
Timber-Kesha ft pibull
Counting stars-One Republic
I Gotta Feeling-The Black Eyed Peas
Boom Boom Pow – Black Eyed Peas
Just Dance-Lady Gaga Feat. Colby O’Donis
Dynamite-Taio Cruz
Give Me Everything-Pitbull
DJ Got Us Fallin’in Love-Usher Ft Pitbull
Poker Face-Lady GaGa
Yeah-Usher
Cupid Shuffle-cupid
Low-Flo Rida
Party Rock Anthem–LMFAO Feat. Lauren Bennett & Goon Rock
Last Dance Song of the Night:

Catch Me-Demi Lovato
Do Not Play:

E.g. Little Apple (小苹果)
